analysis.headline: Shares with Business Partners
analysis.quote: We may disclose personal information with our authorized third parties (such as our service providers, business customers, distributors, research and development partners, contractors, processors, and other authorized vendors) who help with our business operations, including the storage and processing of personal information for the uses listed in this privacy statement.

analysis.headline: Shares with Subsidiaries, Affiliates
analysis.quote: In addition, we may disclose your personal information between and among MediaTek and its subsidiaries and affiliates.

analysis.headline: Explicitly Doesn't Sell Data
analysis.quote: In no event will MediaTek sell, rent, share, trade or disclose personal information to any third party without your permission.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Services
analysis.quote: Some information about your use of the MediaTek Services may be collected using tracking technologies across time and services, and used by us and third parties for purposes, such as to associate different devices you use, and deliver relevant ads and/or other content to you on the MediaTek Services.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Internationally
analysis.quote: Your personal information may be transferred to, stored, and/or processed in Taiwan and/or other countries with different levels of privacy protection than are applicable in your country.

analysis.headline: Retains Data As Necessary
analysis.quote: We will not retain your personal information longer than is necessary to honor your choices, fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by law.

analysis.headline: Publicly Discloses Your Info
analysis.quote: Please remember that any information you choose to disclose in public areas of the MediaTek Services (such as within community forums through a chat feature or published in a product review) may become public information.

analysis.headline: Not For Minors, Parent Involved
analysis.quote: If you are a minor in your country of residence, you may use MediaTek Services only with the involvement of your parent or guardian.

analysis.headline: Inherent Security Breach Risk
analysis.quote: Despite our efforts to protect your personal information, there is an inherent risk of encountering an unexpected security breach in any modern day computing environment.

analysis.headline: Third-Party Links Not Covered
analysis.quote: We are not responsible for the privacy practices or the content of such third-party services, including without limitation social media platforms and their plug-ins that may be on MediaTek Services.
